details.epilogueText:
WARDEN // "Without the loop, Sera, nothing that happened here is preserved."
SERA // "Then we live it once. And we let it end."
SACRIFICE: Every recorded trace of the Nadir-9 crew—and Lysa’s living neural imprint inside the Loom—is permanently extinguished.
PRESERVED: Unconditional peace for the dead; WARDEN can never reconstruct or loop another human consciousness.
WORLD STATE: Core rings decelerate and lock; archive conduits vent into still cyan starlight as Nadir-9 powers down permanently.
ENDINGS RECORDED: 1/3 · LOGS: 6/6
